Customer.title: Customer
Customer.description: A wholesale or retail rice buyer in the Baki Khata ledger.

openingBalance.description: Initial Baki due balance carried over in BDT.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp on creation (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp on last update (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

LedgerTransaction.title: LedgerTransaction
LedgerTransaction.description: A rice sale or standalone payment received recorded in the business and customer ledger.

customerId.description: Customer document ID, or empty string for Walk-in Cash Customer.

customerName.description: Display name of the customer or Walk-in Cash Customer.

type.description: Transaction type: rice SALE or standalone PAYMENT.

riceVariety.description: Rice variety name (e.g., Miniket, Nazirshail, BR-28, Kataribhog).

unit.description: Unit of sale: BAG or KG.

costPricePerUnit.description: Purchase cost price per unit in BDT.

sellingPricePerUnit.description: Selling rate per unit in BDT.

totalAmount.description: Total sale bill amount in BDT.

paidAmount.description: Amount paid in cash/bank in BDT.

dueAdded.description: Net due change added (or subtracted on payment) in BDT.

grossProfit.description: Gross profit from this sale in BDT.

transactionDateMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds of the transaction date.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp on creation (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp on last update (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

BusinessExpense.title: BusinessExpense
BusinessExpense.description: Daily operational expense or monthly fixed overhead expense.

frequency.description: DAILY operational cost or MONTHLY fixed bill.

category.description: Expense category (Transport, Labor, Packaging, Staff Salary, Electricity Bill, Misc).

notes.description: Optional expense description or receipt note.

expenseDateMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds of the expense date.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp on creation (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp on last update (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

BankLoan.title: BankLoan
BankLoan.description: Business bank loan with principal, annual interest rate (default 13%), and installment tracking.

principalAmount.description: Original loan principal amount in BDT.

paidInstallmentsCount.description: Number of installments paid so far.

totalPrincipalRepaid.description: Total principal repaid so far in BDT.

notes.description: Optional loan terms or account note.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp on creation (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp on last update (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/customers/{customerId}.description: Customer Baki Khata profiles owned by the authenticated business owner.

/users/{userId}/transactions/{transactio.description: Rice sales and payment records owned by the authenticated business owner.

/users/{userId}/expenses/{expenseId}.description: Daily operational and monthly fixed expenses owned by the authenticated business owner.

/users/{userId}/loans/{loanId}.description: Bank loans and interest tracking owned by the authenticated business owner.
